description: Trigger evaluation dataset for observability-patterns skill. 6 queries: 3 should trigger, 3 should NOT trigger.

queries.query: Configura OpenTelemetry con Serilog para logging estructurado y distributed tracing
Add custom metrics and distributed tracing with Application Insights integration
queries.note: English trigger: metrics + tracing + App Insights

queries.query: Necesito añadir logging estructurado al proyecto con correlación de requests
Configura Polly retry policies y circuit breaker para los HttpClients
queries.note: NEGATIVE: Debe activar resilience-patterns. Polly retry != observabilidad

queries.query: Set up Azure Key Vault and Managed Identity for the application
queries.note: NEGATIVE: Debe activar cloud-config. Azure services != telemetría

queries.query: Revisa la seguridad de la configuración de logging para que no exponga datos sensibles
queries.note: NEGATIVE: Debe activar security-audit. Auditar seguridad del logging != configurar logging

overlap_notes.resilience-patterns: Health checks: observability = telemetría/métricas, resilience = recovery/retry. Si 'monitorizar' → observability, si 'recuperar' → resilience
overlap_notes.cloud-config: App Insights: observability configura INSTRUMENTACIÓN, cloud-config configura el SERVICIO Azure
